scope: Script-media align sidebar and reader span-media hits can open the same readonly StudioGenerationTraceDrawer via StudioScriptProductUiApi.getStudioTrace → canvas:get-studio-trace. Selected panel/hit without pack/run disables the button and fails closed; does not guess another panel. Drawer is mounted on the product-ring root so reader and align share it.
